title: Rental marketplace slice: listings, filters, inquiries, moderation
what: Stdlib Python and SQLite core of a four-category rental marketplace with role permissions, listing posting, price and location filters, inquiries, reports and an admin moderation queue, plus a mobile-first demo page.
shows: User stories, permissions matrix, end-to-end flow output and a phone-sized page where you post a listing, filter it and send an inquiry.
checks: SQL filter equals plain Python filter
moderation hides listing and blocks inquiries
done: Mobile-first demo page checked in browser
limits: Synthetic data only; in-memory database, no real login, uploads or hosting; demo page keeps posts in the browser only.
